title: From Benchmarks to Production: Transferring Time Series Anomaly Detection Methods for Electricity Production Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.39257v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of electricity production is essential for maintaining the operational efficiency and strategic planning of energy utilities. In industrial settings, such forecasts are generated daily to ensure supply-demand balance and optimal management of production assets. However, the increasing complexity of modern power systems and data flows poses significant challenges for ensuring the reliability and consistency of these forecasts. This paper addresses the problem of anomaly detection in short-term production forecasts at EDF, formulated as identifying atypical intra-day patterns that may signal data quality issues or operational irregularities. We introduce TAMIS, a scalable and interpretable system that analyzes daily production time series to automatically detect anomalous days based on deviations from historical patterns learned from past data. translated_title: 从基准测试到生产环境：将时间序列异常检测方法迁移至电力生产监控
translated_abstract: 电力的准确预测对于维持能源公用事业的运营效率和战略规划至关重要。在工业环境中，此类预测每天生成，以确保供需平衡和生产资产的最优管理。然而，现代电力系统和数据流的日益复杂，给确保这些预测的可靠性和一致性带来了重大挑战。本文研究了EDF（法国电力集团）短期生产预测中的异常检测问题，将其定义为识别可能预示数据质量问题或运营异常的非典型日内模式。我们提出了TAMIS，这是一个可扩展且可解释的系统，通过分析与从历史数据中学习到的模式的偏差，对每日生产时间序列进行自动检测异常日期。TAMIS专为人在环路的工作流程设计，可呈现排名最高的异常……
tldr: 本文提出TAMIS——一个可扩展、可解释的异常检测系统，通过识别每日电力生产时间序列与历史模式的偏差，自动检测EDF短期生产预测中的异常日期，并支持人在环路的工作流程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TAMIS, a scalable and interpretable anomaly detection system that automatically identifies anomalous days in EDF's short-term electricity production forecasts by analyzing deviations of daily production time series from historical patterns, designed for human-in-the-loop workflows.
